name: CPU Guard
summary: Stops known noisy macOS background processes after sustained high CPU, with quiet action-only notifications.
story: My computer should spend cycles on writing, calls, code, and research, not an invisible daemon melting the fan. This is a small guardrail for flow.

launcher.long: Installs a background watcher that throttles macOS background processes when they stay hot too long, using quiet action-only notifications instead of repeated alerts.
